return_methods.plain_language: Mail your completed ballot so it arrives at the elections office by 7:00 PM local time on Election Day.
return_methods.fallback_if_unavailable: Use an official drop box or an in-person return site if those methods remain lawful and available.

return_methods.plain_language: Deposit the ballot in an official elections drop box no later than close of polls.
return_methods.fallback_if_unavailable: Use the elections-office counter return path or the postal return path if still timely.

return_methods.plain_language: Hand deliver the ballot to the elections office during posted public hours.
return_methods.fallback_if_unavailable: Check the official office-closure notice or call the help line for the superseding public return path.

envelope_requirements.plain_language: Place the marked ballot inside the secrecy sleeve, then inside the signed return envelope. Add postage unless the return envelope says postage is prepaid.

packet_requirement_notes: Review the ballot packet and official return page for the exact return deadline semantics that apply to each method.
If you need a specialized military or overseas return path, use the official UOCAVA guidance instead of the ordinary domestic return surface.

special_population_refs.plain_language: Military and overseas voters should use the official UOCAVA return path when their available methods differ from the ordinary domestic return path.

freshness_note: Return instructions are re-verified whenever a deadline, return method, packet insert, or official return location notice changes during the active ballot-return window.
